steps.title: Three imports, three kinds of result
steps.text: `src/index.js` imports `style.css`, `icon.svg` and `data.xml`. The text is red because the CSS is on the page, the icon appears both as the background and as an ``, and the console below shows `note`, the name of the XML file's root element.
steps.textZh: `src/index.js` 导入了 `style.css`、`icon.svg` 和 `data.xml`。文字是红色的，因为 CSS 已经加到页面上；图标既是背景，又是一个 ``；下面的控制台显示 `note`，这是 XML 文件根元素的名字。

steps.title: CSS goes through two loaders
steps.text: A loader is a function that turns a file into JavaScript. The loaders in `use` run from right to left: `css-loader` reads `style.css` and follows its `url('./icon.svg')`, then `style-loader` adds code that puts the CSS into a `<style>` tag when the bundle runs. That tag is in `<head>` now, but `dist/index.html` has none. This step checks the file.
steps.textZh: loader 是把一个文件转换成 JavaScript 的函数。`use` 里的 loader 从右往左执行：`css-loader` 读取 `style.css` 并跟进其中的 `url('./icon.svg')`，接着 `style-loader` 加入一段代码，在打包产物运行时把 CSS 放进一个 `<style>` 标签。这个标签现在就在 `<head>` 里，但 `dist/index.html` 里并没有。这一步会检查这个文件。

action.run: fetch('index.html').then((r) => r.text()).then((t) => console.log('dist/index.html has a <style> tag:', t.includes('<style')))

steps.title: The icon is a file of its own
steps.titleZh: 图标是一个单独的文件
steps.text: `type: 'asset/resource'` copies `icon.svg` into `dist/` under a name made from a hash of its content, and the import gives your code the file's URL. The `` and the CSS background point to the same file, so it is written only once.
steps.textZh: `type: 'asset/resource'` 把 `icon.svg` 复制到 `dist/`，文件名由它内容的哈希生成；导入时你的代码拿到的是这个文件的 URL。`` 和 CSS 背景指向同一个文件，所以它只输出一次。

watch.label: The background uses the same file
watch.labelZh: 背景用的是同一个文件

steps.title: The XML became a string in the bundle
steps.titleZh: XML 成了打包产物里的字符串
steps.text: `type: 'asset/source'` works the other way round: the XML text itself goes into `bundle.js`, and the import gives your code that string, which `DOMParser` then reads. This step searches `bundle.js` for a line of the XML and for SVG markup.
steps.textZh: `type: 'asset/source'` 正好相反：XML 的文本本身被放进 `bundle.js`，导入时你的代码拿到的就是这个字符串，再交给 `DOMParser` 解析。这一步会在 `bundle.js` 里查找 XML 中的一行，以及 SVG 的标记。

action.run: fetch('bundle.js').then((r) => r.text()).then((t) => { console.log('bundle.js contains <to>Mary</to>:', t.includes('<to>Mary</to>')); console.log('bundle.js contains <svg:', t.includes('<svg')); })
